Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 22  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misinterpreted the Wikidata JSON data for Ben Weinman’s birth date by applying an unnecessary and incorrect timezone adjustment. The "time" value in the ISO 8601 timestamp (`"+1975-08-08T00:00:00Z"`) is already normalized to UTC, and no further adjustment to a localized timezone (e.g., converting to Eastern Time) should have been applied when determining a date of birth. The flawed logic resulted in incorrectly identifying the birth date as August 7, 1975, instead of the correct and widely cited date of August 8, 1975. The Planner adopted this incorrect interpretation as authoritative, leading to the incorrect solution being finalized. Thus, WebSurfer introduced an avoidable calculation error that affected the outcome.
